title: VisualPlan
description: projects/<slug>/visual-plan.json: the visual director's per-scene engine decision and the Blender plates the composition needs. HyperFrames is always the compositor; plates are layers inside it. Engines and routing: specs/visual-engines.json.

decided_by.description: heuristic: drafted by `visual-director.py plan` and not yet reviewed; director: the visual director has decided every scene.

plates.description: plate ids used by this scene (required when mode is a plate mode)

reason.description: why this engine: the visual job a cheaper engine could not do

overlay.description: what HyperFrames draws above the plate (text, labels, data)

script.description: Plate script relative to the project folder, normally blender/<id>.py; defines build(lab, job).

template.description: templates/blender/plates/<name>.py the script was copied from (provenance only)

scene.description: storyboard scene id the plate belongs to

start_sec.description: film time the plate starts (data-start of its <video>)

alpha.description: true: transparent film, delivered as VP9 WebM with alpha; false: opaque H.264 MP4

formats.description: formats to render; default every format in project.json. Each format is framed by its own camera aspect, never cropped.

seed.description: seed for lab.rng() and Cycles; default derived from the plate id

cues.description: named moments in plate-relative seconds (e.g. from `studio.py words`), read by the plate script through lab.f(job['cues'][name])

params.description: free parameters for the plate script (palette roles, counts, speeds)
